title: Pioneering Sustainable Clean Air Innovation
description: We build next-generation indoor environmental technology designed to protect human health, reduce carbon footprint, and drive operational efficiency.

story.title: Our Journey & Vision
paragraphs: Founded with the mission to redefine indoor air quality, IntelliGreen combines environmental engineering with advanced IoT analytics and hospital-grade purification.
Today, our systems safeguard thousands of occupants across corporate offices, healthcare facilities, academic institutes, and high-footfall commercial venues.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To transform indoor environments into clean, energy-efficient, and healthy spaces using active AI-assisted air technology.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the global benchmark in intelligent, eco-friendly air management for human wellness and sustainability.

values.title: Health & Safety First
